_readme: Store settings in one place. Fill in the three AdMob ids from apps.admob.com (Apps > Meal Map > App settings, then Ad units). Test builds (build-android.bat) always use Google's test ads; only build-release.bat uses these. Raise versionCode by 1 (and versionName as you like) before every upload to Google Play. starterPhotos: the starter recipes show their original photos (from starter-photos/, not in git). Closed testing only: set it to false before any production release.
